function: Learns SSB and CSI-RS beam codebooks for a hybrid X-MIMO base station, aiming at RSRP close to perfect-CSI SVD beamforming (p. 3, p. 8).
system: Hybrid planar-array BS (16x16 RF elements, 8x4 digital ports, 2-bit phase shifters), 4-antenna UEs, MU-MIMO OFDM, 10 and 20 GHz; no RIS (p. 4, p. 10).
method: Multi-task convolutional network outputs SSB and candidate CSI-RS codebooks, trained end-to-end with an SVD-referenced RSRP loss; unsupervised RSRP-loss fine-tuning for new sites (p. 8, p. 9, p. 14).
data_channel: Sionna ray-traced Munich (10 GHz) and Paris (20 GHz) scenes, 10,000 user locations each; 40,000 training samples with 4 to 16 random users (p. 9, p. 10).
test_conditions: Trained on Munich (10 GHz); tested on newly generated channels, 8x8-to-16x16 arrays and Paris (20 GHz), with and without fine-tuning (p. 10, p. 12, p. 13).
baselines: DFT SSB and CSI-RS codebooks of several sizes (non-learned); beamspace codex neural network from authors' prior work [28] (learned); perfect-CSI SVD beamforming as reference (p. 11).
metrics: Relative RSRP loss versus perfect-CSI SVD beamforming (dB), CSI-RS SNR, effective sum spectral efficiency (bps/Hz) (p. 10 to p. 13).
complexity: CSI-RS selection step needs at most U*Lmax+1 FLOPs plus Lmax FLOPs (p. 5); fine-tuning runs 30 s (p. 13); network inference cost not quantified.
q1_support: p. 9: "We start by generating raytraced channels using Sionna [31]". Munich (10 GHz) and Paris (20 GHz) scenes (p. 10); counted as another public ray-tracing source, not 3GPP TR 38.901, for the reviewer to confirm.
q2_support: p. 13: "a model trained on environment A and retrained on environment B, and the original model from environment A without retraining". Also trained on 8x8 arrays and tested on 16x16 arrays, with fine-tuning (Fig. 8, p. 12).
q3_support: p. 11: "using the proposed X-BM, DFT codebooks, and the neural architecture from our prior work [28]"; p. 11: "achieves a gain of over 6dB on average compared to DFT codebooks"
q4_support: p. 5: "only require at most ULmax + 1 FLOPs for proportioning (9) and Lmax FLOPs for the cumulative sum"; p. 13: "retrained on the 16 × 16 data for 30s"
q5_support: p. 10: "After a database of channels is generated, the neural network is integrated into a processing pipeline". The authors generate their own database with Sionna; no code or data link, and no public channel dataset, is given.
notes: Area 3: the network outputs SSB and CSI-RS beam codebooks; channel estimation (least squares, p. 6) and type-II feedback are fixed, not learned. q1 flagged: Sionna ray tracing on its public Munich and Paris scenes counted as another public ray-tracing source (the BS uses only a 3GPP 3D antenna pattern, p. 10). q4 flagged: it rests on the FLOP count of the CSI-RS selection step (p. 5) and the 30 s fine-tuning time (p. 13); network inference cost is not quantified (5-20 ms in the Fig. 2 caption, p. 7, is a generic span). q5: the generated channel database and the code are not released.
